overview: My E-Com is a fully responsive e-commerce website with a homepage, product catalog, product detail pages, shopping cart, about, and contact pages. Powered by a live product API with real data, cart management with persistence, filtering, and a polished design system.
features: Homepage with hero banner, featured products, category section, countdown offer banner, testimonials, and newsletter signup
Product listing with sidebar filters (category, price, rating, brand), sorting, and responsive grid
Product detail page with image gallery zoom, color/size selectors, and related products
Shopping cart with persistent Zustand state, mini cart drawer, and order summary with coupon codes
About page with team grid, animated stats, and company timeline
Contact page with validated form and contact info
Mobile-responsive with sticky header, hamburger menu, and mobile-first layout
